conclusions.rationale: Absolute value is not differentiable at zero. For every n, sqrt(n)|theta_hat_n|=|Z| exactly, so its law is half-normal, not standard normal. In particular it is never negative.
conclusions.repair: State the half-normal limit, or change the expansion point to one where absolute value is differentiable. The repaired limit changes the distributional guarantee.
conclusions.counterexample: At every n the variable equals |Z|; its probability of being <=0 is zero, whereas the standard normal CDF at zero is 1/2.
